limitations: Live ChatGPT sign-in, usage limits, generation and inference require the user account; no live authenticated request was made during this task.
Speaking feedback uses the transcript; pronunciation and acoustic fluency are explicitly unevaluated. No fabricated audio score is included.
On-device English recognition requires supported device/language assets and permission; manual transcript entry remains available.
Scores and CEFR are formative estimates, not calibrated official IELTS results.
Microphone capture and transcription need a physical-device permission/audio check.
Native iOS navigation and sheet geometry adapt to device size and OS; Figma content, colors, typography and functional states are the reference.
